description: The four perf probes as run on the PYNQ-Z1 on 2026-09-21, imported verbatim. One sample each: this session ran each probe exactly once, so NOTHING here meets the B0 sample policy of 5. Imported as historical reported data, not as a baseline.

source_revision.note: the probes predate this repo's B0 work; their own identities are below

artifacts.note: kernel and disk are not used by bare-metal probes

frequency.derivation: 125 MHz oscillator on pin H16 (create_clock -period 8) through an MMCM at x8/25. NOT measured by any probe here.

memory_layout.note: the target's 256 MiB window maps to PS DDR via the HP port address translation

sample_policy.shortfall_note: 1 sample per workload exists; 4 short of policy

timing_method: core mcycle/minstret (or cycle/instret in S-mode) read either side of the ROI; see benchmarks/metrics.md section 2
output_checks: each probe asserts its own retired count and prints a completion marker; the parser re-checks both and refuses the record otherwise
